'''Plazir-15''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[New Republic Era]], the planet was an independent world under a [[Monarchy|elective monarchy]] with [[direct democracy]].

==Description==
From [[Realspace|space]], Plazir-15 appeared as a lush [[planet]] with large oceans and vegetation. On the surface, the planet was covered in grasslands, rivers, and tropical [[forest]]s. The atmosphere of Plazir-15 was [[Atmosphere|breathable]] for a wide variety of [[humanoid]] [[species]]. The inhabitants of the planet primarily lived in [[Domed city|bio-domes]] which contained urban and metropolitan cities. Outside of the domes were landing pads and a [[Hyperloop pod|hyperloop]] system.<ref name="Chapter 22" />

==History==
{{Quote|You will always be welcome in our domed paradise.|The Duchess, to [[Din Djarin]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]|<ref name="Chapter 22" />}}
For the majority of its history, Plazir-15 was ruled by unelected absolute monarchs from a royal dynasty. [[Galactic Civil War|Following]] the [[Galactic Concordance|collapse]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the leader of [[Royal family of Plazir-15|Plazir-15's royal family]], [[the Duchess]], along with her former Imperial husband, [[Bombardier (individual)|Captain Bombardier]], transformed the planet's monarchy into an elective one, utilizing [[direct democracy]] as its primary form of decision and law-making. The first elections saw the Duchess and Captain Bombardier elected as co-rulers of the planet.<ref name="Chapter 22" />

The act that transformed the planet into its new [[Democracy|democratic]] government was the charter. The charter also stated that the planet shall be pacifistic and pluralistic. Plazir-15 did not wish to join the [[New Republic]] and instead remained independent.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
